application_requirements: Use a new protocol/version; do not overwrite inventory, prepared data, review records, failed report or original plan.
Category changes alter task hashes. Preserve old task/proposal/review bindings and explicitly record any derived metadata transformation; do not relabel old evidence as having new hashes.
Keep the same reviewed task order, mutation allowlists, reference outputs and selection thresholds.
Main chat owns any future evidence-reuse validation, protocol freeze, reservation and launch. This artifact authorizes no retry.
